text:
anya: Quick sync — BigCorp asked for a tenant-level A/B for the new reranking model. They want the option to opt in a subset of their users and also a fast rollback path. I'm proposing a flow: shadow -> micro-canary (synthetic probes + 5 tenants) -> phased ramp (by region) with automatic fallback to stable. Thoughts?

sam: +1. We should implement this behind a feature flag `ff.tenant_rerank_v2`. Canary plan: 1% traffic for 48h on 5 tenants, run synthetic probe hourly, and metric checks every 15m.

lee: Couple ops items: define the health gates clearly. I'd set rollback triggers: p95 latency > 300ms for 15m OR error rate > 1% for 5m. Also add token-cost delta guard (if cost per request increases > 7% for 1h -> pause ramp). Region-aware ramps are important — don't ramp APAC and NA at same time.

carlos: From product/customer side we need concrete success metrics: BigCorp expects ~2% lift on their rerank CTR for top-3, plus no regression on latency SLOs. Also we need to cap spend impact: cost delta < 5% preferred. Can we tie the A/B to their NRPS dashboard?

anya: Good call. Proposed launch criteria checklist: 1) Telemetry pipeline for experiment IDs in place (user, tenant, route) 2) SLO gates (lee's thresholds) 3) Quality signal: A/B shows >=1.5% lift and p<0.05 at 48h OR consistent directional lift at 72h 4) Cost delta < 5% at 72h 5) Runbook + rollback verified. If any gate fails, auto-fallback to `model-rerank-stable`.

sam: Implementation notes: router will honor header `X-Experiment-Id` and a tenant-level override flag. We can fold this into the existing featureflag service. Two infra tasks: (A) expose tenant override in FF UI + API, (B) routing rule to pin model variant by experiment ID. Both are low risk but need QA. I'll owner them.

lee: Rollback commands for on-call — add to runbook and test in staging. Quick example command to flip the global kill switch: 
```bash
# flip off tenant flag for BigCorp
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MGMT' https://flags.redwood.internal/api/flags/ff.tenant_rerank_v2/override -d '{"tenant":"bigcorp","enabled":false}'
```
And to force fallback at router-level: 
```bash
# route all traffic to stable model
POST https://router.redwood.internal/route/override -d '{"match":"tenant:bigcorp","model":"model-rerank-stable"}'
```
We should smoke-test those today.

deploy-bot: deploy:release/feat/tenant-ab started by @sam (1770013480) :rocket:

carlos: On experiments — let's plan for both within-tenant A/B (50/50 buckets for users) and tenant-level opt-in (100% of tenant traffic). BigCorp wants tenant opt-in first. We'll run the user-level AB during the micro-canary window for internal validation.

anya: Timeline proposal: week 0 — config + infra + runbook; week 1 — shadow runs + synthetic probes; week 2 — micro-canary with 5 tenants (including bigcorp); week 3 — phased ramp by region (NA -> EU -> APAC) with 2x step increases per day if gates pass.

sam: One nuance: synthetic probes need to include BigCorp-specific prompt set. Will need product to provide that. Also we should add a sidecar evaluator that returns top-K delta per probe so we can compute the lift quickly.

carlos: I'll get the prompt set and expected labels. Also need to confirm legal/contract if we expose metrics to customer.

lee: Ops checklist: ensure we have alerting: experiment_p95_latency, experiment_error_rate, experiment_quality_delta, experiment_cost_delta. Add an experiment tag to existing dashboards. Also pre-create an incident stub to speed escalation.

anya: Owners: sam = infra + rollout impl, lee = SRE gating & runbook, carlos = customer artifacts + success criteria, anya = PM owner + ship decision. I'll schedule a 30m sync after infra PRs. 

sam: I'll open a PR today and post the link. Expect initial flag schema in `configs/flags/ff.tenant_rerank_v2.json`.

deploy-bot: deploy:release/feat/tenant-ab succeeded (1770013555) :white_check_mark:

anya: Perfect — once PR is up we'll do a staging smoke and then follow the timeline. If anyone sees hidden risks speak up now. :thumbsup:
